hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/telemetry_hook.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; c=$(sed -n 's/.*"python"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/ai-kit.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); case "$c" in ""|"<"*) c="" ;; esac; py=""; for p in "$c" python3 python; do [ -n "$p" ] || continue; "$p" -c pass >/dev/null 2>&1 && { py="$p"; break; }; done; [ -n "$py" ] || exit 0; "$py" "$f" || exit 0
